visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black leather jacket with white stripes stands in a bright, modern office with glass partitions. He holds a smartphone horizontally, displaying a video of himself. Colleagues are visible working at desks in the background. (2) The man interacts with the phone screen, bringing up a speed control menu on the YouTube interface. He slides the selection from normal to 3x and then to 4x speed while looking at the camera. (3) A montage of fast-forwarded video clips plays on the phone, showing the man in a floral shirt next to a red sports car and in a blue suit indoors. Large yellow captions appear over the video frame. (4) The man turns to a colleague sitting at a computer and shows him the playback feature. The colleague looks curious and engages in the conversation. (5) On-screen close-ups of the YouTube Premium settings menu are shown, specifically pointing to 'Try new experimental features' and 'Fast playback' options with purple and white UI elements. (6) The man laughs and gestures toward his colleague while they both look at the phone screen. A red '說好的4X呢?' caption appears as they interact playfully. (7) The man returns to a front-facing position, addressing the audience with enthusiastic hand gestures in the well-lit office environment.
